einstellungen.text: In 1908, something exploded over Siberia. It left no crater.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: Vast Siberian taiga forest at early morning, dark pine trees, thin mist, a blinding white streak of light cutting across the pale sky, vertical 9:16 composition, no people
einstellungen.video_prompt: the white streak races across the sky above the quiet forest, mist drifts, slow push in

einstellungen.text: Witnesses saw a fireball and a flash brighter than the Sun.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: A huge glowing fireball low over a distant forest horizon, intense white and orange light flooding the sky and treetops, dramatic silhouettes of pines, no people
einstellungen.video_prompt: the fireball swells and floods the sky with blinding light, treetops sway

einstellungen.text: It flattened about 2,000 square kilometers of forest.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: High aerial view of an endless forest where thousands of tree trunks lie flattened in a radial pattern pointing outward from one center, soft grey light, no people
einstellungen.video_prompt: slow aerial glide over the fallen trunks, light mist moving between them

einstellungen.text: In 1927, explorers reached the center. No crater, no large fragments.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: Empty swampy clearing in the Siberian wilderness at dusk, scattered fallen bare tree trunks, flat ground with no crater, moody overcast sky, no people

einstellungen.text: Experts say a space rock burst miles up. Nothing landed, yet a forest fell.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: A bright rock streaking through the upper atmosphere over a dark curved Earth horizon, breaking apart in a flash of light, forest far below, no people
einstellungen.video_prompt: the glowing rock breaks apart high above the clouds in a bright flash, the light fades over the calm forest
